description_en: Invokes the AllocateIpv6Address operation to allocate a free IPv6 address or IPv6 prefix CIDR block. The address is not associated with any resource instance (such as a network interface controller (NIC) or Network Load Balancer (NLB)) and exists as an independent IPv6 address in the virtual private cloud (VPC)
description_zh: 调用 AllocateIpv6Address 接口分配一个游离的 IPv6 地址或 IPv6 Prefix 地址段。该地址不关联至任何资源实例（如弹性网卡、网络型负载均衡等），仅作为独立的 IPv6 地址存在于 VPC 中
kebab_example: aliyun vpc allocate-ipv6-address --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vswitch-id vsw-asdfjlnaue4g0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AllocateIpv6Address

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch to which the IPv6 address belongs
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The IPv6 address to allocate. The specified IPv6 address must be an idle address within the CIDR block of the vSwitch
parameters.help_zh: 指定要申请的IPv6地址。指定的IPv6地址必须是在所属交换机的地址段内的空闲地址
parameters.name: ipv6_address

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IPv6 address instance.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
IPv6地址的实例名称。

长度为0～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: ipv6_address_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the IPv6 address instance.

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
IPv6地址的实例描述。

长度为0～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: ipv6_address_description

parameters.help_en:
The type of the IPv6 address. Valid values:

IPv6Address (default): The instance is a single IPv6 address.
IPv6Prefix: The instance is an IPv6 CIDR block
parameters.help_zh:
IPv6地址的类型，取值：

IPv6Address（默认值）：代表当前实例是单个IPv6 IP。
IPv6Prefix：代表当前实例是IPv6 Cidr
parameters.name: address_type

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2381067.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2381067.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. Do not specify an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，请勿输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. You can specify an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs: and cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and business restrictions. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.

false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会查询资源状况。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码DryRunOperation。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

Ipv6AddressId.description_en: The instance ID of the IPv6 address
